name: vagaa-media
description: Produce video, images, music, speech and translations through your own media gateway, with an asset library, a vision review gate and a storyboard pipeline for long video.

media_mcp_url.title: Media gateway MCP URL
media_mcp_url.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint of your media gateway. Example: https://media.example.com/mcp (standard surface) or https://media.example.com/mcp-compact (compact surface). Also the origin the asset-link hook trusts.

media_mcp_token.title: Media gateway token
media_mcp_token.description: Bearer token for the media gateway. Stored in your OS keychain, never in a settings file. Prefer a short-lived token scoped to the media capabilities you actually use.

surface.title: Tool surface
surface.description: Which tool surface the URL above points at: standard (one tool per operation) or compact (a few aggregate tools). Documentation and a session-start sanity check only — it does not rewrite the URL. Allowed values: standard, compact.
